digest.lead: A quiet news day for the Claude ecosystem — no major model releases or product announcements, just a small community project surfacing on Hacker News.
digest.summary: Nothing substantial to report across Claude.ai, Claude Code, or broader community channels today.

stories.headline: Use `claude agents --json` to integrate Claude sessions with external tools
stories.summary: The new JSON output format allows you to programmatically access live Claude session information. This enables integration with terminal multiplexers like tmux, status bars, and custom session management tools.
actionable_steps: Run `claude agents --json` in your terminal to see the JSON output format
Parse the JSON output in your scripts to extract session information
Integrate the JSON data with tools like tmux-resurrect or custom status bars
Set up automated session monitoring or management based on the structured data

stories.headline: Configure worktree base reference to preserve unpushed commits
stories.summary: The latest Claude Code update changed the default behavior for worktrees to branch from origin instead of local HEAD, potentially losing unpushed commits. Setting the baseRef to 'head' preserves your local work when creating new worktrees.

stories.headline: Use `/terminal-setup` to configure smoother fullscreen scrolling in VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.116 improved terminal scrolling performance by automatically configuring your editor's scroll sensitivity. This eliminates choppy scrolling when working in fullscreen terminal mode.
actionable_steps: Open Claude Code in your VS Code, Cursor, or Windsurf editor
Allow Claude Code to configure your editor's scroll sensitivity settings

stories.headline: Pin Claude Code sessions to keep them alive during idle periods
stories.summary: Pinned sessions in Claude Code now persist even when not actively used and are only terminated under memory pressure after non-pinned sessions are closed first. This prevents losing your work context during breaks or when switching between tasks.
actionable_steps: Open Claude Code and start an agents session
Press Ctrl+T to pin the current session
The session will now remain active even during idle periods

stories.headline: Use managed settings drop-in directory for team policy deployment
stories.summary: The new managed-settings.d/ directory allows multiple teams to deploy independent configuration fragments that automatically merge. This enables better organization of team-specific policies without conflicts.
actionable_steps: Create a managed-settings.d/ directory alongside your managed-settings.json
Place individual team policy files in the directory (they merge alphabetically)
Name files with prefixes to control merge order (e.g., 01-team-a.json, 02-team-b.json)
